key_points.point: Verdict real risk with own risk very high (~50%) vs 4% base rate; agrees with the model and thinks it under-ranks the case
Liabilities 8.35x assets, current ratio 0.05, equity -$106.6M; all convertible notes and derivative liabilities reclassified to current
Cash nearly gone: $3.2M ($0.2M restricted), ~1 month of runway at ~$2.9M/month burn, ~2-4 months after ~$7.3M post-quarter inflows; going concern doubt
Covenant stress: minimum-liquidity forbearance (extended through Oct 31, 2024), $4.0M floor vs $3.2M cash unreconciled with reported compliance; management says continued compliance unlikely
Final Nasdaq deadline Dec 9, 2024; delisting is a Fundamental Change allowing a cash put of the $62.9M notes (~20x cash)
Small net loss is an accounting effect of ~$44M non-cash fair-value gains; cash-adjusted loss not shrinking (~-$60M a year)
Lenders keep funding ($4M draws Aug/Sep/Oct, PIK accepted); Athyrium is secured lender and 29.7% shareholder
Equity raises still close (~$3.0M gross in October plus ATM)
Going concern doubt not new (since FY23 10-K) and no defaults reported (Item 3 'None')
Cushions are limited: last $4M draw at holders' sole discretion and ATM capped at $6M

contradictions: Candidate's peer-percentile column mostly reports ratio percentiles in place of the input-level percentiles GOLD gives (current liabilities 97 vs 82, total liabilities 96 vs 69, net income 17 vs 53, operating income 6 vs 35, operating cash flow 6 vs 34); minor because both reports cite the same ratio percentiles in the text
Revenue peer percentile 31 in CANDIDATE vs 21 in GOLD
Candidate says it only 'partly' agrees with the model, while GOLD says it agrees; both say the model understates the distress, so this is framing rather than substance
extra_points_in_candidate: August 2024 deals require a noteholder-approved financial advisor, restructuring milestones and covenants on financing if the company seeks bankruptcy protection
Pending special stockholder meeting on the note and warrant deals
Athyrium holds $18.4M of 2028 notes and may prefer out-of-court fixes
About 165 issued patents could be licensed
Possible recoupment claims from the former lab business and burn after headcount cuts as open questions
summary: CANDIDATE reaches the same real-risk verdict with a slightly lower risk level (high, 45% vs very high, 50%) and covers all of GOLD's critical drivers: extreme leverage with all notes current, about one month of cash, covenant forbearance, and the Dec 9 Nasdaq put trigger. It gives less detail on the cash-adjusted loss trend and the limits on lender and ATM cushions, its peer-percentile column mixes ratio and level percentiles, and it adds a useful point about bankruptcy-financing covenants in the August 2024 deals.
